DLC2315:4:t_003:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let them come! We'll smash every last one of them right here!」

DLC2315:4:t_003:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Are we going to keep living like this... afraid of the shadow of the $$黒歴史$$...?」

DLC2315:4:t_004:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Lady $$ディアナ$$ decided not to look back because she didn't want to live that way, right?! Then don't you be afraid of the $$黒歴史$$, either!」

DLC2315:4:t_004:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you that scared of the $$黒歴史$$?! Is that why you're sealing the $$ホワイトドール$$ away?!」

DLC2315:4:t_004:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I won't accept that! We ought to be able to create a future from the past!」

DLC2315:4:t_004:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Create a future... from the past...」

DLC2315:4:t_004:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「My $$ダブルエックス$$ is a $$ガンダム$$ built anew to overcome the past!」

DLC2315:4:t_004:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$ホワイトドール$$ may be a relic of the $$黒歴史$$, but you can use it to create a future, too!」

DLC2315:4:t_005:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I... We've fought to carry time forward into the future.」

DLC2315:4:t_005:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We can't be afraid of the past...! And that means we can't lose to relics of the $$黒歴史$$!」

DLC2315:4:t_005:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ホワイトドール$$! Your power should be for that, too!」

DLC2315:4:t_005:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Let's go, $$ガロード$$! To protect the present... and the future!」

DLC2315:4:t_006:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「When night ends, morning comes! If the moon's out, that means morning... the future... is coming!」

DLC2315:4:t_007:0.en:
$$パーラ$$
「We did it! A total victory!」

DLC2315:4:t_008:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I gave you that big speech, $$ロラン$$, but inside, I was sweating bullets, too.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Thank you, $$ガロード$$. Even so, you still encouraged me.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It bothered me, hearing people talk like everything about the $$黒歴史$$ was bad.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$ went through a lot of pain and sadness, too, but now she's come to terms with it...」

DLC2315:4:t_008:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Watching her made me think it's wrong to just reject everything in the past.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Lady $$ディアナ$$ feels the same way. I think she wants us to learn from the past and move toward the future, rather than forget it.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...I'm sure the $$ホワイトドール$$ can help us build that future, too...」

DLC2315:4:t_008:10.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Something like today might happen again...」

DLC2315:4:t_008:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And if it does, I won't hesitate to pilot the $$ホワイトドール$$.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:12.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'll use its power to protect peace... to protect everyone.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Until then, it can sleep in the mountain.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And someday... even if nothing comes along to threaten the peace...」

DLC2315:4:t_008:15.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Once I'm confident I can use its power properly, I'll dig the $$ホワイトドール$$ up again.」

DLC2315:4:t_008:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
（Lady $$ディアナ$$... This is the answer I've chosen.）

DLC2315:4:t_008:17.en:
$$ロラン$$
（We'll overcome the past and move forward, learning from it. Using the $$ホワイトドール$$'s power for peace is one way to do that.）

DLC2315:4:t_008:18.en:
$$ロラン$$
（Thank you, $$ホワイトドール$$. Someday, I'll ask to use your strength again.）

DLC2315:4:t_100:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Damn it! First the $$エグゼクター$$, and now things like these show up, too!」

DLC2315:4:t_100:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「How deep does the darkness of the $$黒歴史$$ go?!」

DLC2315:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
（Once again, relics of the $$黒歴史$$ have become our enemies...）

DLC2315:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
（Will our world... remain under the $$黒歴史$$'s control forever...?）

DLC2315:4:t_102:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do this! We'll never move forward if we keep living in fear of the past!」

DLC2315:4:t_102:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'll overcome you and keep going! With my friends... and with $$ティファ$$!」

DLC2315:4:t_103:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
（It's people who carry time forward into the future. That's why I... will never give up...!）

DLC2315:4:t_103:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
（$$ホワイトドール$$... I'll use your power for that...!）

review.context: Garrod challenges Loran's fear of the past. After their victory, Loran chooses to seal White Doll temporarily but use its power again when he can build peace responsibly.
decisions: Garrod's moon-to-morning image deliberately ties his satellite-powered machine to his hope for the future.
Loran's two-row someday sentence remains divided at the same thought boundary.
